g.title: My desk research focused on how agritech teams use soil and weather information. I translated that starting point into a few practical priorities for the interface.
Teams need to understand operational activity, identify conditions that affect decisions, and access the right level of detail for further investigation.

The dashboard combines summary indicators, alerts with plain-language recommendations, detailed weather and soil views, configurable tests, report history, and shared team access to support informed decisions and deeper investigation.
